data.narrative:
RoboTwin is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised €2.3M in EIC funding. The relevant peer universe comprises one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private robotics and manufacturing companies, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable to this valuation. The analysis identified only one same-stage comparable within robotics and manufacturing, with zero adjacent-stage and zero similar-valuation-tier peers. Since robust peer-median analysis requires a minimum of three datapoints within narrow filters, this approach cannot be reliably applied. A fallback to the full eight-company sector median would introduce substantial noise given the heterogeneity typical of robotics venture stages and business models.

Without sufficient narrow-cohort comparables, this valuation cannot be anchored to peer multiples or median entry valuations at present. Further analysis would require either: (1) expansion to adjacent subsectors with defensible structural similarities; (2) accumulation of additional seed-stage robotics transactions; or (3) application of alternative methods such as cost-of-capital or discounted cash flow frameworks, neither of which are supported by the data provided. The key uncertainty is the absence of reliable market reference points for early-stage robotics valuations in this geography and technology domain.
